residual_plan.blocked_by: Trusted Windows code-signing certificate, signtool.exe, and clean Windows verification machine.
residual_plan.done_when: Signed installer and clean-machine install, upgrade, rollback, and uninstall verification pass.

residual_plan.task: Harden RAG prompt handling for untrusted document content
residual_plan.done_when: Document snippets are explicitly isolated and documented as untrusted context, with tests covering instruction-in-document attempts.
residual_plan.evidence: RAG context is serialized as untrusted JSON fields and ChatServiceTests covers marker and role injection attempts.

residual_plan.task: Add focused API contract drift tests
residual_plan.done_when: Critical C# DTO responses and TypeScript client expectations are checked by focused contract tests or generated contract validation.
residual_plan.evidence: InProcessBackendContractTests now compares critical C# DTO response property names and enum literals against src/OnlyRag.Web/src/api.ts TypeScript client contracts; dotnet test OnlyRag.sln passed.

residual_plan.task: Add user-facing cancellation or bounded timeout for OCR provisioning
residual_plan.done_when: OCR runtime provisioning has a documented cancel or timeout path that stops child processes and leaves a clear recoverable status.
residual_plan.evidence: OCR provisioning now has a confirmed cancel endpoint, UI cancel action, 45-minute backend timeout, process-tree cancellation through LocalProcessLauncher, tests for cancellation token propagation, and documentation in docs/OCR_PIPELINE.md and docs/OPERATIONS.md.

residual_plan.task: Validate and bound WebView chat and draft storage
residual_plan.done_when: Session/local storage payloads used for chat and translation drafts are schema-checked, size-bounded, and safely cleared when corrupt.

residual_plan.task: Redact sensitive local details from user-facing external error messages
residual_plan.done_when: Errors from external tools and services separate user-facing text from technical log detail and avoid unnecessary local path, host, or environment disclosure.

residual_plan.task: Split broad UI controller files when next touched
residual_plan.done_when: Large active UI controller files above review thresholds are split by responsibility during related feature work, with focused tests preserved.

commands.frontend: cd src\OnlyRag.Web; npm run format:check; npm run typecheck; npm run lint; npm run test:unit; npm run test:e2e; npm run build
